Offshore Development Guide

The Reality Facing Businesses Today

Software development costs are rising continuously across North America. Local talent hiring is costly, competition is fierce, and delivery timelines keep slipping while budgets stay flat. Teams that once relied on a single in-house group now look further afield for capacity.

Why Offshore Works

An offshore team gives access to a far larger pool of engineers at a predictable monthly cost. The trade-off is coordination overhead, which disciplined handover practices and overlapping hours largely remove.

The most successful arrangements treat the offshore group as a first class part of the engineering organisation rather than a vendor kept at arm's length from the real decisions.
